findings.text: follow-on: the comment "(0+1)/2 = 0.5" and the name at line 120 still describe a per-comparator mean-rank merge, but the delta replaced that merge with rrf_fuse_in_input_order at imas_codex/standard_names/context.py:1154, so the test misstates the mechanism it guards.

follow-on: compose_worker discards the seat the rerank now returns and adds its spend only to state.compose_stats.cost at imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py:4000, a telemetry counter, so the rerank there is charged to no lease and reduces no budget, unlike the batch path at imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py:2065.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the switch-on reorder test that fails with the call removed, the fragment citing test_rerank_pool_keeps_the_pool_order_when_every_judgement_fails, and the compose/context plus judgment gate; the manifest records baseline 827 passed/0 failed and after 842 passed/0 failed at 9258a1ada with EXIT=0 (head_gate_c.log), and negative_control.log shows the reorder test red at EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the source node's goal is a default-off Jev rerank of the compose comparator block; this delta (1e08155c22cb..80765e568) adds no capability but answers the three prior follow-on findings, seat-correct booking at imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py:2010, the caller-side guard at imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py:1999, and the fusion reuse at imas_codex/search/fusion.py:45.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records baseline_suite and after_suite each with revision, exit_status and completed:true at logs that resolve on disk with an EXIT= summary, plus three negative-control logs and the three defects answered by commit.

justifications.evidence: head_gate_c.log:1 names revision 9258a1ada and the full file list, and its 842 passed/EXIT=0 summary is recorded in the manifest's after_suite against the 827-passed base arm.

justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py:2010 books the rerank under the seat that billed it and imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py:1999 guards the call, so the two named defects land as directed and imas_codex/search/fusion.py:45 answers the reuse one.
